references.text: The fulfillment of Moses' words: the earth opened its mouth and swallowed Korah, Dathan, and Abiram with all they owned, and they went down alive into Sheol.
A look back at how the earth opened up and swallowed the rebels as a warning sign for Israel.
Moses reminds the people of what the Lord did to Dathan and Abiram when the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them.
The psalm describes how the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, and closed over Abiram's company.
Sheol opens its mouth wide to swallow, a parallel to the earth opening its mouth.
The earth opened its mouth to receive Abel's blood from Cain's hand—the same expression about the earth opening its mouth.
Proverbs uses the image of Sheol swallowing people alive, like those who go down into the grave.
Jude mentions Korah's rebellion as a warning example of disobedience against God.
